boundary.description: From the junction of Moss Bridge Road and Kingsway, E along A6193, to junction 21 on M62 Motorway, S by Newhey Road, Shaw Road, Milnrow Road to the point where it meets Shaw and Crompton and Newhey railway. By a beeline to and W along Mossgate Road to the point opposite Higher Rise (road), then by a beeline excluding all of Greenhill Avenue, crossing Rochdale Road and Castleton Road (near Gravel Hole Methodist Church, Pit Lane), to and W along Thornham Lane, to its junction with Oldham Way, and then following Oldham – Rochdale District boundary and by a bee-line to M62 junction 20 , N along the motorway to and E along Rochdale Canal Greenfield Lane, Queensway, Kingsway to the junction of Moss Bridge Road and Kingsway.
